problems: No Cliopatria row is owned by this batch; all 13 dossiers are new states with cliopatria_names [] and every keyframe is new (verdict adjust) with county-level or radius regions, since the pages give no maps.

Cross-group slugs: kingdom-of-albania and principality-of-albania-thopia use the slugs suggested by eu-18-d and eu-18-e; the dossier "serbs" (eu-18-f, 1804-1918) is used as the counterpart of the Serbian uprisings and was not read beyond its identity; the Habsburg and Ottoman counterparts use the slugs in polities.csv.

Pages open via WebFetch return a model summary, not raw wikitext; quoted sentences are as the summary gave them, and where the summary said "page silent" the dossier records confidence 1 or leaves the event out.
Eastern Rumelia lasted seven years (below the ten-year rule) but is the counterpart of Bulgaria's 1885 gain flagged by eu-18-h.

Type colony was used for the Habsburg units and Venetian Dalmatia, type state with family islam-west for the Ottoman units; the Cliopatria Ottoman Empire and Republic of Venice rows already cover much of the same land, so the renderer should treat these as sub-units.
Dates of Old Style versus New Style are noted only for Eastern Rumelia (6 versus 18 September 1885).
